capabilities.justification: The loader/CLI read the curriculum's lesson Markdown, direct per-lesson curriculum membership owners, concept taxonomy, per-language sound-tag owners, direct exam-point owners, per-task-shape reading-reach floor owners, per-lesson modality owners, and script JSON from the repo working tree to build and validate the cross-language dataset.

The loader enumerates each track's lessons/ and curriculum-membership.d/ directories, core/sound-tags.d/, core/exam-inventory-*.d/, core/reading-reach-floor.d/, core/lesson-modality/*.d/, and data/scripts/ to discover and verify the exact files to parse.
The explicit generate:books command refreshes configured LaTeX chapters from the canonical lesson AST; CI normally uses the read-only check:books drift gate.

The explicit generate:books command refreshes stable metadata and chapter-owned app/book source-hash files inside registered language directories; CI normally verifies them without writing, and no flat aggregate is written.

The explicit generate:modality command refreshes only direct per-language metadata and per-lesson modality owners; it cannot write the removed flat aggregates. CI normally uses the read-only check:modality drift gate.
The explicit generate:narration command refreshes the HL08 plain-text voice script for each chapter from the canonical lesson AST; CI normally uses the read-only check:narration drift gate.
The explicit generate:narration command refreshes the HL08 structured narration a voice agent consumes; CI normally uses the read-only check:narration drift gate.

The explicit generate:narration command refreshes stable metadata and chapter-owned source/output hash files inside registered language directories to detect drift between lessons and committed voice scripts; CI normally verifies them without writing, and no flat aggregate is written.

Test-only: the vitest setup caches each track's parsed lessons and narrated chapters (v8-serialized, content-addressed, in sibling lessons/ and narration/ directories) in a private 0700 directory (on Windows, which has no mode bits, only this fixed package-local directory) so the suite parses and narrates the corpus once per run instead of once per test file. CLI and generator processes never enable it. Entries are written as 0600 temp files, renamed into place, and a track's superseded entries are deleted.

justification: Filesystem access stays in loader-backed CLI entry points. Validation/reporting are read-only; the explicit generators write only configured LaTeX chapters, per-chapter narration scripts, chapter-owned generated-hash files, and direct per-lesson modality owners. The only other filesystem use is the test suite's parsed-lesson and narration caches under node_modules/.cache/human-language-data, which the vitest setup enables and the CLI never does. No network or process access is needed.
